summary: Frontend-only mobile testing of the new Deep Analytics + Multi-Timeframe Comparison feature on the Expo web preview (viewport 390x844). Completed owner login (owner@ananta.ai) and full onboarding wizard (Welcome -> Research First -> capital $25,000 -> allocation -> pick 1 strategy -> summary -> Start Paper Trading -> Enter Ananta), dismissed the ComingSoonPromo welcome sheet, then tapped the 'Deep Analytics' entry on the Cockpit (below Strategy Health) which correctly navigates to /analytics. All required testIDs are present and populated (analytics-screen, analytics-back, an-performance + 6 stat cells, an-strategies with an-strat-hunter/squeeze/continuation, an-timeframes with all 3 chips, an-exits). Chip switching (an-tf-strat-hunter/squeeze/continuation) works. Back button returns to the Cockpit. Portfolio Performance and Exit Breakdown correctly show their empty-state messages because there are 0 closed trades in the paper account. Multi-Timeframe Comparison correctly shows the graceful 'No timeframe data yet' empty state — which is acceptable per the review request. NOTE: I probed /api/lab/health from the browser after the sweep completed (7 strategies returned, best_timeframe populated e.g. hunter=30m, squeeze=15m, continuation=1h) but every strategy's timeframe_comparison array came back empty ([]) so the mobile screen has no rows to render. Empty-state UX is correct, but flagging this as an observation for the main agent to sanity-check the backend _merge_timeframes() output on the live preview.
empty_states_observed_and_correct: Portfolio Performance: 'Equity curve appears after trades close.' (0 closed trades — expected)
Multi-Timeframe Comparison: 'No timeframe data yet — run a Health sweep to populate.' (backend returned timeframe_comparison=[] for every strategy despite best_timeframe being populated)
Exit Breakdown: 'No closed trades yet.' (0 closed trades — expected)

backend_observation.note: Called directly from the browser during test. Response has 7 strategies with best_timeframe correctly set (hunter=30m, squeeze=15m, continuation=1h, ema-cross=1h, supertrend=1h), but every strategy's timeframe_comparison array is []. Not a mobile bug (screen gracefully falls back to empty state as designed), but main agent may want to sanity-check that _merge_timeframes() is actually persisting rows into the returned payload on the preview environment. Review note said this was already unit-verified so it may still be a sweep timing issue.

critical_code_review_comments: analytics.tsx is 276 lines, single-purpose, DRY — clean.
Stat/EquityCurve extracted as small local components, StyleSheet.create used correctly, all text wrapped in <Text>, testIDs on every interactive/informational element — good.
Empty-state handling is done at three levels (curve, strategies, timeframes, exits) with clear user-facing copy — good UX.
computeStats() and exitBreakdown() are pure helpers memoized via useMemo — good.
Minor (non-blocking): profit_factor renders as '∞' (unicode) when there are only winning trades — correctly guarded.
action_items: Optional: sanity-check backend /api/lab/health on preview — timeframe_comparison arrays are empty for every strategy even though best_timeframe is populated. Mobile screen handles this gracefully with the intended empty-state message, so no mobile fix required. If the sweep timing note in the review request no longer applies (sweep already fully done), main agent may want to verify _merge_timeframes() is running/persisting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested mobile Analytics feature (all testIDs present, navigation + back + chip switching + empty states all working)

seed_data_creation: None (used the fresh paper account created by the owner onboarding wizard)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner onboarding wizard must be completed every browser session (session doesn't persist between fresh Playwright launches). Sequence: login -> onboarding-start-exploring -> onboarding-start-paper -> two 'onboarding-continue' clicks (capital, alloc) -> pick any strat-* item then onboarding-continue -> onboarding-finish -> click 'ENTER ANANTA' text -> dismiss welcome-sheet-continue. After that the Cockpit exposes cockpit-analytics-link which pushes /analytics. If timeframe_comparison arrays get populated, the an-tf-row-1h/30m/15m rows would render with a ★ next to the best_timeframe row (verified via code review: analytics.tsx L172-180).
